messages:
Rae: quick UX flag from the dashboard QA — the update modal feels cramped and the primary CTA sits almost glued to the footer actions on 360px. screenshot: https://img.redwood/mock/modal-compact-flag.png
Omar: yep. looks like inconsistent vertical tokens — header uses `space-2` but body uses `space-4`. propose a `modal-breath` token with `compact` and `default` values so designers can pick intent.
Issa: a11y note: toasts are currently injected inside the modal container and sometimes steal focus on show. make toasts non-focusable by default and mount them in a global portal so they don't disrupt modal keyboard traps.
Kim: copy nit: primary button says "Confirm" but action is applying settings. suggest "Apply changes". the toast reads "Saved" which feels vague; match the CTA: "Changes applied".
Omar: implementation plan — add `modal-breath` tokens, expose `toast.portal = true` option, and add `toast.avoidSelectors = ['.modal']`. will include snapshot tests for 360px and 1024px.
Issa: motion/accessibility: respect `prefers-reduced-motion` for toast animations and avoid focus shifts. also increase close icon hit area to 44px using padding+negative margin so visuals don't shift.
Rae: design preference: anchor toasts top-right on desktop and bottom-center on mobile. document this in toast component docs and note exceptions for global banners.
TokBot: visual regression queued: modal-breath token + toast portal (run id d4f9a).
Kim: tiny follow-up — add a changelog entry for the CTA copy change so PMs know the labels updated. thanks all :thumbsup:
